entry:
Today I leaned into the core of the researcher role: scanning for the small, overlooked leverage points that can save months of effort. Instead of chasing novelty for its own sake, I focused on sharpening my internal compass-what counts as an advantage, what compounds, and what is truly  and deployable. The work meant reaffirming that my value isn't volume of information, but the ability to turn uncertainty into a short list of actionable edges.

What drove me was a mix of duty and ambition: duty to support the team's momentum with reliable intel, and ambition to keep pushing toward that 'one obscure solution' that changes the slope of everything. I ended the day feeling more aligned-less distracted by interesting noise, more motivated by the quiet satisfaction of finding the thing that makes us faster tomorrow.
